dedupe_keys.name: estonian health statistics and health research database tai pxweb population morbidity health care use health care resources medicines and health behaviour tables

description: This PxWeb database is Estonia's official store of health statistics, maintained by the National Institute for Health Development (TAI). Its tables are grouped into population indicators, morbidity, use of health services and reasons for treatment, health care resources and their use, health behaviour, use of medicines, and statistics drawn from the national health information system. Coverage is national, with many tables split by county, sex and age over multi-year series. Users choose a table and variables and can export the result; the database is free and available to download in PxWeb formats such as CSV and Excel, with a glossary of terms, though no licence is stated on the page read. Caveats: table definitions and years differ between sections, and the interface is primarily in Estonian. Simulation uses: sizing hospital beds and workforce by county for surge planning, estimating demand for services in scenario studies and tracking health service use after disruptive events. Related records: the WHO health infrastructure indicators (data-who-gho-health-infrastructure-indicators) give comparable national figures, and GISCO healthcare services (data-gisco-healthcare-services-europe) locate Estonian hospitals.
